1.title: Nutti the Squirrel and the Secret of Nuts
1.text: Once upon a time there was a lively squirrel named Nutti who lived in a big oak tree. Nutti was different from other squirrels - he loved mathematics!

2.title: Preparing for Winter
2.text: Autumn was coming and Nutti knew he had to collect nuts for the winter. But how many nuts would he really need?

3.title: The Power of Multiplication Tables
3.text: Nutti remembered that his grandmother had taught him multiplication tables. 'If you collect 7 nuts a day for 8 days, how many will you have in total?' grandma had asked.

4.title: The Adventure Begins
4.text: Nutti decided he would learn all the multiplication tables perfectly. This way he could quickly calculate how many nuts he would have at any time!

5.title: Join Nutti's Adventure!
5.text: Now you can help Nutti learn the multiplication tables! Every correct answer helps Nutti collect nuts for the winter. Are you ready?

funFacts.page3: Did you know? 7 × 8 = 56 nuts! That would last Nutti almost two weeks.
funFacts.page5: Tip: Use the keyboard: 0-9, Enter, Backspace and H (hint)!
